title: Browser frame
summary: The real product in a browser: the address types close up, the page loads and settles, the camera travels down it with pauses.

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

params.name: image
params.description: a full-page screenshot of the product (tall); empty draws a stand-in page in the brand's colours

params.name: format
params.description: output size; the layout recomposes for each

usage:
npx paper-motion add browser-frame --name my-browser-frame
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-browser-frame/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-browser-frame/scene.html --motion-blur 5
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work) and, for the field, a shader-set entry.
Recomposes for 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1: set `format` and the layout and camera follow.
when: show a real site or web app
a tour of a long page
